objective: Classify and repair all triangle-free fixed-color leaf obstructions attaining both ten vertices and eleven edges.

atomic_claims.text: Exactly six rooted colored types occur, up to graph isomorphism and a global color bijection, under both size equalities.
All six edge tables are proper star colorings of H with all six colors forbidden on uv.
The six girths are 6,5,5,5,4,5; DD is the unique bipartite type within this simultaneous-extremal class.
Each of the six types has exact old-edge edit distance one, with the displayed exhaustive boundary audit.

assumptions: G is finite, simple, subcubic and triangle-free, with exactly ten vertices and eleven edges.
v is a distinguished leaf at u and c is a star six-edge-coloring of G-v with no unchanged-color extension.
Equivalence retains the distinguished leaf and neighbor while permitting one global palette bijection.
risks: Both vertex and edge equalities are essential; ten-vertex graphs with additional edges are outside the classification.
This is a manual structural classification, not an executed enumeration.
The repair proof must exclude internal four-cycles as well as endpoint four-edge paths.
The result does not imply universal one-edit repair or the root six-color bound.
